boundaries.counterfactual: Same hypothetical 100 MW workload and 120-month calendar opportunity; grid-connected versus dedicated gas generation. Neither represents an actual Microsoft campus.
boundaries.capex_timing: Land, building, cooling, power infrastructure and mitigation paid at month zero. Hardware and working capital paid at commissioning. Replacement hardware paid at the start of its next service cycle, only if operation remains inside the common horizon.
boundaries.tax: Simplified monthly cash tax on positive taxable income only. No immediate loss refunds, loss carryforwards or tax credits. Straight-line capital allowances start at commissioning; no claim about actual tax entitlement. Disposal losses receive no assumed tax relief.
boundaries.horizon: Fixed end at month 120; delay consumes the opportunity window. Constant purchasing-power dollars and an assumed real 8% discount rate; no inflation or growth. No continuing-business terminal multiple.
boundaries.asset_lives: Engineering scenario assumptions, not Microsoft accounting lives or site guidance. Hardware economic replacement life and assumed tax-allowance life are separate. Tax allowances stop at disposal; remaining tax basis receives no assumed loss relief. No replacement except IT hardware within the supported horizon; other assumed lives must cover it.
boundaries.power: Generation size, availability, gas delivery and permits are assumed sufficient for the workload. Grid variable price is a delivered-price assumption; on-site fuel, variable O&M, fixed O&M and capital are separate. No grid backup/resale credit in the on-site case.
boundaries.cyber: A single conditional incident in a specified calendar month; no occurrence probability or expected annual loss. Recoverable workload is removed from lost revenue and annual net energy loss; fixed costs remain.
boundaries.valuation: Project discounted cash flows only. No calibrated issuer valuation, market-implied expectation, stock target, or position recommendation. No separate ESG risk premium.
boundaries.source_policy: Every numeric operating and financial model input above is an analyst assumption. Primary-source observations are separately registered in evidence/ and public-data/.
